roadmap.title: Visual priority on operations map
roadmap.detail: Differentiate orders by urgency, prep time, and first-order badge. Today everything looks red — sellers can't decide what to attack first.
quotes: Bahia: 'Then since everyone is red… some differentiation to know which ones are left'
Puebla: first-order badge actively used and valued across POCs

roadmap.title: Metrics: date range selector
roadmap.detail: Replace fixed 7-day window with day, week, and month selectors. Sellers need yesterday's numbers to manage today's team.
quotes: CDMX 4/4: want daily filter like previous app
Churubusco: 'I miss that part because this one goes away for the last 7 days'
Zavaleta: wants orders-per-hour view (today via Ale's Excel)
Peru 3/3: KPI screen locked to rolling 7 days; ranking peer set opaque; SLA 35 hidden

roadmap.title: Reimbursement: detailed breakdown of what they receive
roadmap.detail: Weekly reimbursement report with line-by-line degloss: commercial difference, coupons, last mile, refunds, and final payout. Sellers today reconcile in Excel/notebook because they don't trust or understand the platform number.
roadmap.impact: Each payment line explained in plain language · Weekly PDF export per store (concept validated in visit) · Drill-down from total → concept → order list · Seller can spot-check a random order against payout
quotes: Interview script: 'Do you understand each line? What's left to trust in the final number?' — Figma concept tested
Bahia: 30 min/week manual reconciliation in Ricardo's Excel; does not use app financial report
Los Alpes: notebook + daily Excel; wants to degloss for random spot-check
Churubusco: trusts payment but cannot audit order by order in platform

roadmap.title: Metrics: AI copilot (MVP)
roadmap.detail: Pre-defined explanations per metric ('what this means' + 'what to do if red'). Weekly plain-language summary — not open-ended chat.
quotes: CDMX: sellers don't understand ranking, fulfillment score, or what impacts it
Talabera: limited KPI use — checks delivery time visually only

roadmap.title: Map + kanban on one screen
roadmap.detail: Combine real-time map (couriers + order pins) with stage columns (waiting / preparing / ready). Drag ready orders to assign on map without leaving the view.
quotes: CDMX 4/4: operations map is most-used screen at peak; requested map + kanban together
Interview script: Figma concept tested in every CDMX visit

roadmap.title: Multi-assign orders to courier already en route
roadmap.detail: After courier accepts order A, seller can bundle compatible orders B and C going the same direction. Courier confirms or rejects the batch.
quotes: Zavaleta: 'Cannot assign second order to courier on route'
Churubusco: still uses Telegram to route multiple orders
Peru La Marina: #3 ask — assign second order to courier already en route

roadmap.title: Metrics: hourly operational view
roadmap.detail: Orders per hour vs couriers per hour. Compare today vs yesterday vs same day last week.
quotes: Zavaleta: wants orders-per-hour + couriers-per-hour in platform
CDMX: forecast shows 30 expected, 7 arrived — can't staff by eye
Peru La Marina + Merino: WebPO demand-by-hour praised; want same in seller KPIs

roadmap.title: Reassign order after courier starts
roadmap.detail: When courier is sent to load but can't complete, seller reassigns without canceling — similar to Tucan flow Churubusco referenced.
quotes: Churubusco: 'Prefer to reassign as in Tucan'

roadmap.title: Financial report: export to Excel
roadmap.detail: Export reimbursement and sales breakdown for taxes, courier payments, and accountant. Parallel spreadsheets today because export is insufficient.
quotes: Churubusco: export financial report to Excel requested
CDMX cross-store: payments, taxes and refunds in parallel spreadsheets

roadmap.title: Reliable daily order forecast on home
roadmap.detail: Fix inflated or missing forecast so sellers can staff couriers with confidence. Show range, not false precision.
quotes: Bahia: marked 30, 7 arrived
Los Alpes: ignores forecast, staffs by eye

roadmap.title: Unified portfolio: minimum + full catalog
roadmap.detail: Single navigation for minimum portfolio and full catalog.
quotes: Mixcoac: two confusing screens with different product sets
Los Alpes: 183+ SKUs reviewed manually

roadmap.title: Courier Financial Report (Jumbo): earnings statement
roadmap.detail: Weekly payment communication directly on courier app — summary by concept, line by line. V1 without order-level detail; dream: on-demand statement.
quotes: Product meeting: launch Courier Financial Report this week
Widely used on Sundays for payment closure
Dream: statement on request + direct bank transfer (complex: customer bank account)
